name: ai-instructions
blurb: Searchable instruction picker with ability to create custom AI prompt modifiers.
description: A component system for managing AI instructions with a popover interface. Includes search, preset groups, create dialog, and state management for active instructions.
use_when: Building AI interfaces where users customize prompts or system instructions before sending.
avoid_when: For simple button toggles — this provides a full UI for instruction management.
a11y: Uses dialog and popover primitives with command palette search. Keyboard navigation via Command component.
